claims.text: The FDA adalimumab label says patients taking concomitant immunosuppressants such as corticosteroids may be at greater risk of infection; this class includes budesonide.
claims.quote: Patients 65 years of age and older, patients with co-morbid conditions and/or patients taking concomitant immunosuppressants (such as corticosteroids or methotrexate), may be at greater risk of infection.

headline.text: The FDA adalimumab label identifies greater infection risk with concomitant immunosuppressants, including the corticosteroid class containing budesonide.

reported.text: The warning covers corticosteroids as a class and does not quantify a budesonide-specific effect.
